shots.title: Cold open
shots.framing: ECU inside the surf viewport. No cockpit chrome in frame.
shots.action: A cursor reads a paragraph and highlights a phrase, like a person would. Slow push-in.

shots.title: Pull back: the cockpit
shots.framing: Pull back to a WS of the laptop. The live cockpit fills the screen.
shots.action: The compact top bar comes into view with battery %, drain rates and time to empty. Battery ticks down 1%.
shots.vo: It's Battery Surf Bench, measuring how fast real browsing drains your battery.

shots.title: Logo
shots.framing: Centered lockup on the Coastal Daybreak sky.
shots.action: A wave wipes the frame. The surfing-battery mascot rides in and lands on the beat, then the wordmark and tagline settle.
shots.vo: The battery benchmark that browses like a human.
shots.read: The battery benchmark that browses like a human.

shots.title: The timer test
shots.framing: Flat graphic in gray. A stopwatch and a stack of identical pages.
shots.action: Pages flip mechanically, one per tick: load, wait, next.
shots.vo: Most battery tests flip pages on a timer.

shots.title: It reads
shots.framing: MCU of the viewport: article page plus the bark pill.
shots.action: The caret highlight sweeps a sentence. Bark pops: "Deep in the good words…"
shots.read: READS · Deep in the good words…

shots.title: It watches
shots.framing: MCU of the video page player.
shots.action: The hand cursor clicks play and the video rolls. Bark: "Ooh, moving pictures!"

shots.title: It lingers
shots.action: The cursor dwells on one image with a gentle zoom. Bark: "Ooh, shiny pixels…"

shots.title: It moves on
shots.framing: MCU of the link hub, ending on a whip-pan.
shots.action: Bark: "Paddling off to the next page…" The page whips away to the next one.
shots.vo: And moves on when it gets bored.
shots.read: MOVES ON · Paddling off to the next page…

shots.title: Personalities
shots.framing: CU of the deck's Surfer section: class chips and stat sliders.
shots.action: Tap Scholar, then Doomscroller: the five sliders swing within the 25-point budget; two quick drags build a custom surfer.
shots.vo: Pick a personality, or build your own.
shots.read: Pick a surfer, or build your own

shots.title: Your own pages
shots.framing: MS of the Settings screen in wp-admin: browse pane and selected pages.
shots.action: Click Add on a post. It slides into the sequence, then a drag reorders it.
shots.vo: Surf the built-in course, or your own posts and pages.

shots.title: Unplug. Start.
shots.framing: Two inserts: the charger plug, then a CU of the Start button.
shots.action: The cable pulls out and PLUGGED IN turns into START. Click, and the run begins.

shots.title: Live readouts
shots.framing: CU of the readouts: battery, 10-min rate, session rate, time to empty.
shots.action: The numbers update as samples land. Slow push across the readout row.
shots.vo: Battery level, drain rate, time to empty. All live.
shots.read: Battery · Rate 10 min · Rate session · Time to empty

shots.title: Honest math
shots.framing: Graphic: the battery staircase on a chart.
shots.action: Samples land as dots while it reads "calibrating…". Then a least-squares line snaps through them and a dashed projection runs to empty.
shots.vo: Every rate is fitted to your real battery curve. No guesswork.

shots.title: Postcard + sessions
shots.framing: MS of the summary postcard, then a slide to the Sessions grid.
shots.action: The postcard flips to its verdict, the franked stamp lands, then the Sessions log slides in.
shots.vo: Each run ends in a postcard, and every session is saved.

shots.title: Private by design
shots.framing: Three icon chips on the sky gradient.
shots.action: The chips pop in one by one: Operator-only, No telemetry, Saved on your site.
shots.vo: No telemetry. Your data stays on your site.
shots.read: Operator-only · No telemetry · Saved on your site

shots.title: End card
shots.framing: Logo lockup, "Free WordPress plugin", fine print, waves along the bottom.
shots.action: The lockup settles and holds for about 1 s after the VO, while the cockpit’s shark fin surfaces at +0.85 s, cruises across the waves with its wake, and dives at +4.0 s.
shots.vo: Battery Surf Bench. Unplug, and find out.
shots.read: Battery Surf Bench · Free WordPress plugin · Requires a Chromium-based browser on a battery-powered device.
